# contractes.cat

Independent open-data project about public procurement in Catalonia.

## For AI agents

HTML pages are protected against scrapers. Use the read-only JSON API or the CLI instead.
The JSON API needs no key and accepts any HTTP client (curl, fetch, requests).
Please keep it under ~5 requests/second; there is a per-IP limit of 300 requests/minute.

All endpoints are GET, return `{"data": [...]}`, and paginate with `page=N` (1-based).
Text search is accent- and case-insensitive.

- Contracts: `https://www.contractes.cat/api/contractes?search=<text>`
  - Filters: `year`, `nif` (awardee tax id), `awardee_name`, `nom_organ` (contracting body), `tipus_contracte`, `procediment`, `amountMin`, `amountMax`, `date_from`, `date_to` (YYYY-MM-DD)
  - `sort`: `date-desc` (default), `date-asc`, `amount-desc`, `amount-asc`
  - `format=csv` for CSV
- Companies (awardees, ranked by awarded amount): `https://www.contractes.cat/api/empreses?search=<text>`
  - `cpv=72,48` filters by CPV division; `format=csv` for CSV
- Contracting bodies: `https://www.contractes.cat/api/organismes?search=<text>&limit=N`
- Top companies for a body: `https://www.contractes.cat/api/organismes/top-empreses?organ=<exact organ name>&limit=N`
- People (company owners and administrators from BORME): `https://www.contractes.cat/api/persones?search=<name>`
- Contracts linked to a person: `https://www.contractes.cat/api/persones/<NAME>/contractes` (optional `date_from`, `date_to`, `nom_organ`, `sort`)

Human-readable pages to cite for users:

- Company: `https://www.contractes.cat/empreses/<NIF>`
- Contracting body: `https://www.contractes.cat/organismes/<organ name>`
- Person: `https://www.contractes.cat/persones/<NAME>`

## CLI

- Package: `@gerardgimenezadsuar/contractes-cli`
- Binary: `contractes`
- Install: `npm install -g @gerardgimenezadsuar/contractes-cli`
- Quick help: `contractes help`

## Main CLI commands

- `contractes search-contracts --search "<text>" [--year YYYY] [--nif <id>] [--page N]`
- `contractes search-companies --search "<text>" [--cpv 72,48] [--page N]`
- `contractes search-organs --search "<text>" [--limit N] [--page N]`
- `contractes organ-top-companies --organ "<organ name>" [--limit N]`
- `contractes person-contracts --name "<person>" [--date-from YYYY-MM-DD] [--date-to YYYY-MM-DD]`
- `contractes attribution`

## API base URL

- Production: `https://www.contractes.cat`
- Override for CLI: `CONTRACTES_API_BASE=<url>`

## Attribution

Dataset shown by contractes.cat comes from:

- Dataset id: `ybgg-dgi6`
- Publisher: `Departament d'Economia i Hisenda`
- Source portal: `https://analisi.transparenciacatalunya.cat`
- License/terms: `https://administraciodigital.gencat.cat/ca/dades/dades-obertes/informacio-practica/llicencies/`
